doc.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001

title: Ronnie Scott's old club and Lucky Thompson
summary: He visited Ronnie Scott's first basement club in Soho and heard Lucky Thompson there once.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well we know of course that Ronnie had started a club, and I went to the early club a couple of times in what they call Ronnie Scott’s old place, which was a sort of small basement which had been formerly a taxicab driver’s place in Soho. What they call a cabman’s shelter. It was where cabbies could go and have an off-duty cup of tea. And Ronnie got hold of it and he started the club. And I remember seeing Lucky Thompson there, a small room about half the size of this space we’re in, at about two and six pence, which is like, well that’d be fifty cents or something, and I heard Lucky Thompson. That’s the only time I heard Lucky Thompson.
